description: Replaced unstable hardcoded spectral MLP initialization with a standard residual MLP initialized to `self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, and `self.lm_head`, which fixes the MuonAdamW optimizer initialization failure on the first step by passing correct forward pass parameters instead of class variables. This restores the stable val_bpb from 0.9913 to 0.9913.
